score_definition: Frozen native G/L/S/A; no recalibration or new score transforms

unavailable_families.matched_Control_247: Separate namespace; no ready compatible calibrated score family in the authoritative catalog

cohorts.incomplete: role=target AND NOT all dataset-wide has_tissue fields; asserted disjoint from original
cohorts.other_complete_targets: Reported in inventory; excluded from the two independent main cohorts
cohorts.maximum_component: Repaired legacy baseline only; descriptive overlapping subset, never a third replication

nuisance.numeric: Midranks within the exact tested donor subset; centered/scaled nuisance columns for numerical conditioning
nuisance.constants: Remove and record constant nuisance terms; never outcome-guided covariate deletion
nuisance.deficiency: NA inference for rank deficiency, missing covariates, constant score/outcome or inadequate residual df

models.B: Unadjusted on exactly C complete-case donor IDs
models.C: Partial correlation of residualized score/outcome midranks on base nuisance design
models.study: C separately within ROS and MAP in brain; same base covariates with constant study term removed; motor not applicable

eligibility.smaller_adjusted: Descriptive effect only where estimable; no adjusted primary p/q

permutations.statistic: two-sided absolute Spearman rho; adjusted absolute partial rho (monotone equivalent of full-model t on the fixed design)
permutations.exact: Enumerate one-vector unique multiset pairings if min permutation space <= min(100000, floor(8000000/N)); identical tie configurations share their full null distribution
permutations.unadjusted: Unrestricted one-vector pairings; exact where tractable, otherwise fixed-budget Monte Carlo
permutations.adjusted: Freedman-Lane: reduced outcome-on-nuisance residual permutation, fitted values added back, full-model refit via equivalent orthogonal projections; ranks/design fixed
permutations.blocks: Pooled brain adjusted residual permutations restricted within study; within-study and single-MAP motor unrestricted within their study
permutations.empirical_p: (exceedances+1)/(draws+1); exact tail proportion includes all pairings; no empirical zero p
permutations.assumptions: Residual exchangeability within study; Freedman-Lane is not universally exact or heteroscedasticity robust
permutations.degenerate_draws: Conservatively count undefined permuted residual norm as extreme; record count
permutations.resolution: Family-wide 9999 draws frozen before scan; floor 0.0001. Flag every correction family with alpha/m < floor and every floor-limited test; no outcome-driven refinement

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile donor bootstrap; study-stratified with fixed stratum sample sizes; B/C share each resample
bootstrap.refit: Rerank score, outcome and numeric nuisance terms and refit each replicate
bootstrap.degeneracy: Record valid/degenerate replicates; CI unavailable if fewer than 80% are valid; changing nuisance design columns is degenerate
bootstrap.limitation: 199-replicate catalog intervals are coarse; 1999-replicate focused intervals are the detailed readout

canonical_hypothesis: Within each module namespace only: identical physical edge-universe hashes AND equivalent native values/denominators share one hypothesis. Prefer resolved tissue/pair; list all aliases. Never merge module families or call aliases independent replication.

correction.new_q_scan: BH within dataset/cohort/allocation/model/study-stratum/native/unmasked; all ready registered canonical physical hypotheses, eight outcomes, G/L/S/A and both betas
correction.new_q_GL_outcome: BH jointly G/L within the same context and fixed beta/outcome, across all registered ready module families/components
correction.exclusion: Retain NA rows with reasons; only finite p enter BH. Correction before display filters, Top K or focused selection. q is within-model, not permission to choose the best model.
correction.repaired_baseline: All original 20-outcome numeric Spearman tests use declared tie-aware permutation inference; nominal KW p unchanged. Recompute both complete original legacy correction families, preserving aliases and all unchanged tests; old release stays immutable.

focused.selection: User-named candidates and DLPFC / DLPFC-PCG components declared before running the scan; all outcomes shown, including attenuated/unavailable effects
focused.spline: Natural restricted cubic age spline: four knots at 5/35/65/95% of native age in the exact complete-case subset, three age df; knots fixed for permutation and bootstrap; recorded per test
focused.pathology_sensitivity: Focused cogng_demog_slope only: base covariates plus ranked gpath/amyloid/tangles, contingent on verified source provenance. Never add pathology again automatically to cogng_path_slope; do not substitute global cognition for an unavailable slope.
focused.interaction: Pooled standardized midranks on the exact pooled donor subset; nuisance main effects + score + study + score-by-study. HC3 covariance with t/F reference and residual df; require each study N>=30 and full-model df>=20.
focused.comparators: Same family/module unmasked historical LIONESS control-anchored native Connectivity and same-module constituent tissue PC1 eigengenes, reusing existing fits. Shared score/outcome/covariate/comparator donors; unavailable inputs reported, never substituted.
focused.joint: Reduced base+available declared comparators versus same model+G+L jointly on identical donors; standardized pooled midranks, HC3 two-df Wald F, delta in-sample R2 with stratified donor bootstrap; rank/condition number/VIF diagnostics; no predictive interpretation
focused.focused_fdr: Each focused model/cohort/stratum tested as a declared within-focused family across all named modules/components, endpoints and both betas; retain broad catalog q for primary A/B/C

technical_covariates: Inventory RIN/PMI/batch/cell composition and preprocessing provenance only; none added automatically
exclusions: No prediction, reclustering, beta/mask optimization, matching, weighting, new calibration, donor IDs in public aggregate tables, publication, production pointer change, push or merge
